# The counter

The workshop takes in bicycles every morning and returns the same day the ones it can repair without a part it does not keep.

- A repair that needs a part the workshop does not keep takes three working days, and the customer is called first.
- A bicycle that arrives after the counter closes waits until the next morning, and its ticket is written then.
- A repair the workshop cannot do, like the frame of a carbon bicycle, is sent to the workshop of the next town.
- A customer who leaves a bicycle for more than a month without an answer is called before it is stored again.
